phase_F3_A_galois_closure: Identify Gal(N/F) ≅ S6 from accepted monodromy of chi_u (already S6 on the (1,2,3,s) line and claimed geometrically).
Fix H = stab(root) ≅ S5 with K_proj = N^H.
Do not re-prove monodromy; hash-pin the accepted monodromy certificates.
phase_F3_B_E3_module: Compute the 3-division field M = F(E[3]) or its compositum MN with N.
Determine image G = rho(Gal(Fbar/F)) ⊆ GL_2(F_3) as a concrete matrix group (order dividing 48).
Present E[3] as an explicit F_3[G]-module of rank 2 (or as Gal(N)-module after inflation).
Aut(L/F) ≅ N_G(H_v)/H_v for H_v = stab of a nonzero vector — compute here if needed; do not assume 1.
phase_F3_C_finite_cohomology: Compute H^1(G, E[3]) by cocycle enumeration or Magma/GAP/Hecke cohomology for the small group G (|G|≤48).
Identify the class [xi] with the Kummer class of alpha_R under the CFOSS isomorphism w1.
Compute restriction along H_K := rho(Gal(Fbar/K_proj)) ⊆ G (or the preimage of H in the extension 1->Gal(M/N)->... ), evaluating res([xi]) in H^1(H_K, E[3]).
phase_F3_D_cross_check: Compare boolean res(xi)=0 with F2 exit (cube / noncube of alpha_L).
Disagreement is a certificate bug, not a mathematical fork — both must use the same xi and the same CFOSS convention.
